about: Font families for Pixel Studio, fetched from Fontsource npm packages by scripts/fonts/fetch.mjs. Hebrew: every Fontsource family with a hebrew subset. Latin: a curated set of popular families. Per font: package (the variable package when there is one), version (pinned by `node scripts/fonts/fetch.mjs --pin`), category (our name for it), hebrew (expected to have Hebrew letters). For Hebrew fonts, checked once in the woff2 files with fontTools (every hebrew file of the family): yiddish = has U+05F0-05F2 (the double letters) and the points U+05B4, U+05B7, U+05B8, U+05BC, U+05BF; niqqud = has every vowel point U+05B0-05BC (sheva to dagesh); missing = which of U+05B0-05BD, U+05BF and U+05F0-05F2 the font lacks (U+05BD, meteg, is a stress mark and not needed for niqqud). Fonts marked local are not on Fontsource: scripts/fonts/culmus.py (local: "culmus") and scripts/fonts/extra.py (local: "extra") make their files in public/fonts/<id>/ and fetch.mjs reads them from there. addYiddish: add the Yiddish double letters and rafe the font lacks (scripts/fonts/yiddish.py); yiddish, niqqud and missing then describe the font after that. Optional choices: weights (static weights to take instead of 400 and 700), noItalic (leave out italic files), note.
